_comment: Helper config for the RSFQ test-bench tools. Design-derived values (clock frequency, PTL delay, core pitch, die size, I/O nets) are exported by the app to <stem>.tb.json next to <stem>.cir; point the tools at that folder with --dir. Nothing here is tied to a particular design.
_comment2: Stimulus knobs. clockPeriodPs <= 0 means derive it from freqGHz in the design config (period = 1000/freqGHz). useInputWindow uses the exporter's inputWindowTarget* bounds; startupPeriods skips extra clock edges. settlePs is the earliest absolute launch time; the earlier of clock/data starts there. inputWindowMode is start|center|end|positive (end avoids the too-early edge of the derived window). dataPhasePs is only the fallback when inputWindowFound is false. pipelineLevels is the fallback max clock depth (the exporter writes it into <stem>.tb.json). outputWatchStart = clockSend + (pipelineLevels-1)*period + minOutputTravelPs (the travel figure already includes the final level trigger); decodeStartPeriods shifts the decode window by whole periods. timeStepPs/josimMaxRows keep JoSIM's time-point memory in check (measured: 80k points OK, 100k crashed on an 8 GB box). probeClockJunction/probeOutputJunction name the junction inside the testbench's DCSFQ-PTLTX / PTLRX-SFQDC instances that the phase probes address - a library-specific detail.
